column3: “Have I cried for help” is rendered “will I call for help.”
“Wickedness and mischief” is rendered “iniquity … wickedness”; NASB renders “do you look at?” as “cause me to look on,” and “it has been” as “exists.”
“Grows numb” is rendered “is ignored,” and “not it comes forth to perpetuity justice” “justice is never upheld.”
“See … look” is rendered “Look … Observe,” and “a deed” “something”; “if it will be recounted” is rendered “if you were told.”
“The nation” is rendered “people,” and “bitter” “fierce”; “goes to the expanses of the earth” is rendered “march throughout the earth.”
“Dignity” is rendered “authority,” and “from itself it comes forth” “originate with themselves.”
“Paw the ground, its warhorses” is rendered “Their horsemen come galloping”; “making haste” is rendered “swooping down.” The singular “it” is rendered “they” throughout.
“The totality of their faces is eastward” is rendered “Their horde of faces moves forward.” The meaning is uncertain.
“He is guilty” is rendered “they will be held guilty”; NASB adds “But.”
“To judgment … to reprove” is rendered “to judge … to correct,” and “it” “them.”
“For seeing evil” is rendered “to approve evil,” and “look to mischief” “look on wickedness with favor”; NASB supplies “with favor” and “Why.”
NASB supplies “The Chaldeans” for the subject and renders the singular as plural.
“Make smoke” is rendered “burn incense,” and “his portion is fat” “their catch is large.”
“Not will he spare?” is rendered “without sparing.”
